item.title: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma Shine, Robin Uthappa Criticizes Gautam Gambhir
item.description: Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma showcased stellar performances against South Africa, yet Robin Uthappa criticized coach Gautam Gambhir for not praising them. Kohli scored 302 runs, Rohit 146, helping India win the ODI series 2-1.

item.title: Aligarh Encounter: Police crack down on robbery duo in dramatic shootout; Watch video
item.description: Aligarh police foil daring robbery spree! Two dangerous criminals injured in a dramatic encounter, Rs 74,000 cash and jewellery seized- what shocking secrets did the busted duo reveal?

item.title: US Seizes Venezuelan Oil Tanker, Escalating Tensions in South America
item.description: The US seizure of a Venezuelan oil tanker escalates regional tensions and threatens Chinese economic interests. Maduro faces intense pressure while Trump’s military actions spark global scrutiny and risk destabilizing South America amid growing geopolitical conflicts.

item.title: Modi and Trump Discuss Trade Over Call: Will the US Remove Tariffs on India?
item.description: India and the US are intensifying trade deal talks as leaders review strategic partnerships. Key sectors like agriculture, energy, and defense are discussed, with India urging the US to finalize the FTA promptly for mutual economic growth.

item.title: Delhi Expands to 13 Districts to Simplify Governance and Boost Administrative Efficiency
item.description: Delhi increases its districts from 11 to 13 to streamline governance. The reorganization aligns revenue districts with municipal zones, ensuring efficient administration, better public services, and improved resource management across the national capital.

item.title: Ex-ISI Chief Faiz Hameed Sentenced to 14 Years: Pakistan Court-Martials Top Spy for the First Time
item.description: Former ISI chief Faiz Hameed has been court-martialed and sentenced to 14 years for misuse of power and leaking classified information. This unprecedented action signals a major shift in Pakistan’s civil-military dynamics, especially against Imran Khan’s close aides.

item.title: THIS CM’s air travel bill from 2023 to 2025 surges beyond Rs 47 crore; Details inside
item.description: A comprehensive expenditure record presented in the Legislative Council reveals a sharp rise in charter aircraft and helicopter spending for the Karnataka Chief Minister across a thirty month period marked by extensive statewide and inter city travel.

item.title: Hair Growth Remedies: What science says about onion juice, rice water, caffeine and rosemary oil
item.description: Struggling with hair growth? From onion juice to rice water, caffeine, and rosemary oil, some remedies promise miracles but which actually work? Discover what science says and which treatments might really boost your strands.

item.title: US Warns Tourists: No visa if purpose is childbirth for citizenship; Details inside
item.description: Planning a US trip to give birth for citizenship? Think again. The US embassy warns tourist visas could be denied if the real intent is ‘birth tourism,’ as the Supreme Court weighs a historic challenge to birth right citizenship.

item.title: Codeine Syrup Case: ED conducts raids in various states including UP; Two arrested
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate has raided 25 locations in Lucknow, Varanasi, Jaunpur and Saharanpur in Uttar Pradesh, as well as Ranchi in Jharkhand and Ahmedabad in Gujarat.
